title: piper angsiense
intro: Piper angsiense, commonly known as Long Pepper, is a flowering plant in the family Piperaceae, native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Piper angsiense include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Piper angsiense include piperine, a compound that has been shown to have antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, as well as other alkaloids and phenolic compounds.
